context: A boss and his manager prep an office move
purpose: Teach: 市役所/フロア/洗練/ハードディスク/大物/スマート/本題/紙面

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 市役所からの認可、いつ届く?
lines.en: When will the city hall approval come through?
lines.style: Clipped, businesslike opening. Direct gaze. No wasted breath. The question of someone checking a box on a list before moving on.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 来週です。新フロアは、洗練されたデザインになっています。
lines.en: Next week. The new floor is getting a refined design.
lines.style: Steady, informational. Slight emphasis on 'refined'—not salesmanship, just fact. Level tone, maintaining eye contact. Understated but competent.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 本題に入ろう。データ移行、ハードディスクは新規調達か。
lines.en: Let's get to the real agenda. Data migration—are we sourcing new hard drives?
lines.style: Shift into sharper focus. Slight forward lean. Efficient. The questions come faster now. No digression, just priorities.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。大物の役員も視察予定です。
lines.en: Yes. A senior executive from head office is scheduled to tour.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact delivery, but with a touch of weight on the executive visit. Not nervous—just establishing the stakes. Clear, no hedging.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: スマートな運用で、紙面でも好意的に報じてほしい。
lines.en: I want this handled cleanly. I need the press to cover it favorably.
lines.style: Firmer now. Quiet authority. Not demanding, but the expectation is clear. Deliberate pace. Slight emphasis on 'cleanly.'

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.style: Efficient wrap-up. Brief nod, accepting the task. Confident, no flourish. The punctuation mark on the conversation.
